title: From Tiny Seed to Jack-o'-Lantern
summary: A true story of how a pumpkin grows, from one tiny seed in spring to a long curly vine, yellow flowers, busy bees, a green pumpkin turning orange, and a cozy glowing jack-o'-lantern on the porch.

title: Ollie Otter and the Moon's Hiccups
summary: When the moon gets the hiccups and can't fall asleep, a little otter and his friends try every silly trick until a gentle lullaby and a hug do the job.
